tools.description: The niri desktop: outputs, workspaces with their windows (id, app, title; focused, urgent, opened by seimei), the keyboard layout and whether the screen is locked (input tools refuse while it is). Start here before acting. With display: "agent": the agent display's windows.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: desktop

tools.description: See the screen. Without a window: the whole screen as JPEG; click and scroll take pixel coordinates from this image. With a window id: that window alone at full resolution, even on another workspace, for reading (not for click coordinates). region [x, y, w, h] (pixels of the whole-screen image) or target (bar: the status bar; top or bottom: half the screen): that part at full resolution, under 800 KB, for reading small text. It returns the image's path: Read it to see the image (only when you need to look; the path stays valid for the last 30 shots). show=true puts the image in the chat and returns the image itself. With display: "agent": the agent display; a window id there is focused first (each window fills that screen).

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: screenshot

tools.description: Run a niri action, as `niri msg action <action> <args>` takes it. Common ones: focus-window --id N, focus-workspace <idx|name>, move-window-to-workspace --window-id N <idx|name>, close-window --id N, fullscreen-window --id N, maximize-column, set-column-width <50%|+10%>, toggle-window-floating --id N, toggle-overview, switch-layout <idx>, power-off-monitors, quit. Closing a window seimei did not open and quit wait for the user's OK on their phone.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: niri

tools.description: Read-only niri state as JSON (niri msg --json <what>): outputs, workspaces, windows, focused-window, focused-output, layers, keyboard-layouts or version. For details the desktop tool leaves out.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: niri_query

tools.description: Start an app or command in the desktop session. It runs outside seimei, so it survives seimei restarts. Its window goes to the "seimei" workspace unless workspace is "current", and counts as seimei's (closing it needs no OK). With display: "agent" it opens in the agent display instead, which starts on first use (Firefox there: use the browser tools with browser: "agent"). Returns the new window's id.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: open_app

tools.description: The agent display: a screen of seimei's own (a nested niri on the "seimei" workspace) with its own keyboard and pointer, where agent apps get input without taking the user's focus or mouse. It starts on first use by open_app or the agent browser and stops itself after a while unused, closing its apps. go: status (size, windows, memory), start or stop.
tools.name: agent_display

tools.description: Type text into a window: it is focused first, and typing stops if focus moves away. ASCII only; the US layout is switched on while typing. With display: "agent" it types into a window of the agent display, any characters, without touching the user's focus.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: type_text

tools.description: Press keys or combinations in a window, in order, like ["ctrl+l"], ["enter"], ["alt+tab"], ["super+shift+e"]. Names: letters, digits, punctuation, enter, esc, tab, backspace, delete, space, arrows (up/down/left/right), home, end, pageup, pagedown, f1-f12, ctrl, shift, alt, super. With display: "agent": a window of the agent display.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: press_keys

tools.description: Click at pixel coordinates of the latest whole-screen screenshot. Pass the window you expect there: the click is refused if it is no longer focused. count=2 double-clicks, count=0 only moves. With display: "agent": pixels of the latest agent display screenshot; the window, if given, is focused first.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: click

tools.description: Scroll with the wheel at pixel coordinates of the latest whole-screen screenshot; positive amount scrolls down, in wheel clicks. With display: "agent": pixels of the latest agent display screenshot.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: scroll

tools.description: Read a window's accessibility tree (AT-SPI): roles, names, states, actions and text, each with a path for ui_action. Works for GTK apps like Quod Libet; Firefox, Vesktop and kitty usually expose nothing. Use filter to keep only matching elements.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: ui_tree

tools.description: Act on an element from ui_tree: run one of its actions (like click or activate), or set the text of an editable field. Works without moving the mouse or stealing focus.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: ui_action

tools.description: Recent desktop notifications from mako: what is showing now and the history, newest first.
tools.name: notifications

tools.description: Read the text on the clipboard. The user's clipboard asks them with an Approve card first (it may hold a password); with display: "agent" it reads the agent display's own clipboard, without a card.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: clipboard_read

tools.description: Unlock the lock screen with the password the user saved for seimei. You never see the password. Use it only when a task needs the desktop while the screen is locked.
tools.name: unlock_screen

tools.description: Bring back the desktop layout from before the last niri restart or reboot: apps on their workspaces, kitty windows in their folders, the user's Claude sessions resumed. Without go=true it only lists the plan; with go=true the user gets one Approve/Deny card for all of it.
tools.name: restore_desktop

niri.prompt:
## Desktop
Drive the computer with your desktop tools (start with desktop), not `niri msg`, grim or ydotool in Bash: niri can restart, and your shell keeps the old socket.
- Work in the agent display (display: "agent" on the desktop tools, browser: "agent" on the browser tools): it has its own screen, keyboard and pointer, so the user's focus and mouse stay theirs. Touch the user's display only when the task is about something there; then focus stealing is fine, and apps you open go to the "seimei" workspace (open_app does that).
- Closing a window you did not open, quitting niri and editing ~/.config/niri wait for the user's OK on their phone; ask in chat first when the reason is not obvious.
- screenshot returns the image's path: Read it when you need to look (show=true puts it in the chat and returns the image).
- Never type into a window you have not just looked at. Prefer keyboard shortcuts and typing over clicks.
- The user has a stop key on the computer. When they press it, your turn ends and desktop input is blocked for a minute: do not resume driving until they say so.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: ui_tree

tools.description: Act on an element from ui_tree: run one of its actions (like click or activate), or set the text of an editable field. Works without moving the mouse or stealing focus.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: ui_action

tools.description: Unlock the lock screen with the password the user saved for seimei. You never see the password. Use it only when a task needs the desktop while the screen is locked.
tools.name: unlock_screen

tools.description: Bring back the desktop layout from before the last KDE Plasma restart or reboot: apps on their workspaces, kitty windows in their folders, the user's Claude sessions resumed. Without go=true it only lists the plan; with go=true the user gets one Approve/Deny card for all of it.
tools.name: restore_desktop

kde.prompt:
## Desktop
Drive the computer with your desktop tools (start with desktop), not  in Bash: KDE Plasma can restart, and your shell keeps the old socket.
- Focus stealing is fine and you may use the user's workspaces, but apps you open for a task go to the "seimei" workspace (open_app does that).
- Closing a window you did not open waits for the user's OK on their phone; ask in chat first when the reason is not obvious.
- screenshot returns the image's path: Read it when you need to look (show=true puts it in the chat and returns the image).
- Never type into a window you have not just looked at. Prefer keyboard shortcuts and typing over clicks.
- The user has a stop key on the computer. When they press it, your turn ends and desktop input is blocked for a minute: do not resume driving until they say so.

tools.description: The GNOME desktop: outputs, workspaces with their windows (id, app, title; focused, urgent, opened by seimei), the keyboard layout and whether the screen is locked (input tools refuse while it is). Start here before acting. With display: "agent": the agent display's windows.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: desktop

tools.description: See the screen. Without a window: the whole screen as JPEG; click and scroll take pixel coordinates from this image. With a window id: that window alone at full resolution, even on another workspace, for reading (not for click coordinates). region [x, y, w, h] (pixels of the whole-screen image) or target (bar: the status bar; top or bottom: half the screen): that part at full resolution, under 800 KB, for reading small text. It returns the image's path: Read it to see the image (only when you need to look; the path stays valid for the last 30 shots). show=true puts the image in the chat and returns the image itself. With display: "agent": the agent display; a window id there is focused first.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: screenshot

tools.description: Run a GNOME window action: activate, close, minimize, maximize, fullscreen or above with a window id (and on or off to set instead of toggle), to-workspace with a window id and a workspace number or name (a new name takes the empty last workspace), workspace with a number to switch to it. Closing a window seimei did not open waits for the user's OK on their phone.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: gnome

tools.description: Read-only GNOME state as JSON: windows, workspaces or outputs. For details the desktop tool leaves out.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: gnome_query

tools.description: Start an app or command in the desktop session. It runs outside seimei, so it survives seimei restarts. Its window goes to the "seimei" workspace unless workspace is "current", and counts as seimei's (closing it needs no OK). Returns the new window's id. With display: "agent" it opens in the agent display instead, which starts on first use (Firefox there: use the browser tools with browser: "agent"). Returns the new window's id.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: open_app

tools.description: The agent display: a screen of seimei's own (a headless GNOME Shell on a bus of its own, seen through screenshots only) with its own keyboard and pointer, where agent apps get input without taking the user's focus or mouse. It starts on first use by open_app or the agent browser and stops itself after a while unused, closing its apps. go: status (size, windows, memory), start or stop.
tools.name: agent_display

tools.description: Type text into a window: it is focused first, and typing stops if focus moves away. ASCII only; the US layout is switched on while typing. With display: "agent" it types into a window of the agent display, any characters, without touching the user's focus.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: type_text

tools.description: Press keys or combinations in a window, in order, like ["ctrl+l"], ["enter"], ["alt+tab"], ["super+shift+e"]. Names: letters, digits, punctuation, enter, esc, tab, backspace, delete, space, arrows (up/down/left/right), home, end, pageup, pagedown, f1-f12, ctrl, shift, alt, super. With display: "agent": a window of the agent display.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: press_keys

tools.description: Click at pixel coordinates of the latest whole-screen screenshot. Pass the window you expect there: the click is refused if it is no longer focused. count=2 double-clicks, count=0 only moves. With display: "agent": pixels of the latest agent display screenshot; the window, if given, is focused first.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

tools.name: click

tools.description: Scroll with the wheel at pixel coordinates of the latest whole-screen screenshot; positive amount scrolls down, in wheel clicks. With display: "agent": pixels of the latest agent display screenshot.

display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)
